articles.title: India beefing up space-based surveillance after border conflict
articles.summary: India plans a major upgrade to its national security by launching over 50 new spy satellites. This initiative aims to significantly enhance surveillance capabilities, including crucial night-time imaging, addressing past security challenges. The ambitious program underscores India's commitment to bolstering its strategic intelligence infrastructure, providing comprehensive monitoring essential for national defence and security preparedness.

articles.title: Russia Is ‘Without Question’ a Threat in the Arctic, Carney Says
articles.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney informed world leaders in Davos that Russia poses a clear, albeit currently prospective, threat in the Arctic. This highlights the region's increasing geopolitical importance and growing international concern over Russia's activities. Aspirants should note the strategic implications for international security and the need for vigilance in this vital northern area.
